description: This file contains API functions for managing and retrieving organization (tenant) data, including listing organizations and fetching organization summaries, with external API calls and data normalization.

methods.name: listOrganizations
methods.description: Fetches and returns a sorted list of organizations (tenants) for the current user, normalizing various ID and name fields.

methods.name: getOrganizationSummary
methods.description: Builds a summary for a tenant including id, name, total cost, and user count, with optional navigation data fetch.
